Shift from premiumization to value-for-money positioning.
Greater use of livestreaming, creator commerce, and platform-native advertising.
Tighter inventory and demand forecasting to avoid post-festival overstock.
Reduced emphasis on headline GMV figures and more focus on profitability, repeat customers, merchant support, and user engagement.
Diversification beyond China domestic demand, including cross-border e-commerce and overseas markets.
